# Values And Shapes

Zero-heavy bar chart.

```mdf-bar-chart
key,value
None,0
Tiny,1
Small,2
Large,100
```

Decimal values.

```mdf-horizontal-bar-chart
key,value
Latency,12.5
Throughput,98.75
Errors,0.25
Saturation,63.4
```

No header row.

```mdf-bar-chart
Alpha,8
Beta,16
Gamma,32
```

Non-chart fenced code should remain ordinary code.

```text
mdf-bar-chart
This is text, not chart data.
```
